13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __wherein the contact elements are positioned to maintain both pneumatic gas flow through the first portion and electrical power transmission simultaneously__.

14. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body __that is structurally distinct from the flexible tube and the heater__.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __via a mechanical fastening system__.

16. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the sheathing body __such that the heater is thermally coupled to the flexible tube through the sheathing body__.

17. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design __comprising at least an inner insulating layer and an outer protective layer__.

18. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube __having heating elements embedded within the tube wall__.

19. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube __such that heating elements are disposed within the flexible tube material__.

20. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection __that is fluidically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

21. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __that is fluidically connected in series with the tube arrangement__.

22. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __that supplies water vapor to the respiratory gas__.

23. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube __and includes a water chamber__.

24. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material __that provides structural rigidity while maintaining flexibility__.

25. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater __that generates heat when electrical current is supplied through the contact elements__.

26. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __wherein the contact elements are electrically conductive and positioned to avoid obstruction of gas flow__.

27. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion __and is electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

28. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __to accommodate the contact elements__.

29. (Currently amended) A connector for connecting a CPAP device to a respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the respiratory gas tube arrangement including a heater, the connector comprising: a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage; and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to the heater, wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device, __wherein the contact elements are electrically conductive and positioned to avoid obstruction of gas flow through the first portion__.

30. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein each contact element is provided within the second portion __and is electrically isolated from the respiratory gas passage__.

31. (Currently amended) A connector according to claim 29, wherein the first portion is tubular and the second portion extends outwardly from the first portion __to accommodate the contact elements__.
